• "Keystone species play a disproportionately large role in maintaining the structure and stability of their ecosystems."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 2 follows** by providing the historical background and origin of the concept:
 
 
• "The concept of a keystone species was first introduced by ecologist Robert Paine, who studied the effect of removing certain predators from an ecosystem."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 5 is the third sentence** because the phrase "This idea" directly connects back to the concept introduced by Robert Paine in the previous sentence:
 
 
• "This idea revolutionized ecology by highlighting how some species have a far greater impact on their environment than others."

• "For example, sea otters help regulate sea urchin populations, preventing the destruction of kelp forests."

• "Without keystone species, entire ecosystems can collapse, leading to significant biodiversity loss."

• The original subject of the sentence ("the policy") becomes the object of the active infinitive.
 
• Retain the adverbial phrase "in complete secrecy" at the end to preserve the full meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"External advisors are supposed to have drafted the policy in complete secrecy."*

• **Retention of Structure (Inversion):**
 
 
• When a sentence begins with a restrictive condition like "Only if," it requires subject-auxiliary inversion in the main clause. The structure "would the applications be processed" accurately reflects this rule and matches the indirect prompt exactly.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb and conjunction:**
 
 
• The conjunction "that" is removed.
 
• The reporting clause ("said the official") is placed outside the quotation marks, separated by a comma.

• The sentence starts with a capital letter "Only".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
